ignore.reason: The rules run inside Rector, whose package bundles the parser in its own vendor/; requiring it would install a second copy.
The PHPUnit and Webmozart rules match those classes in the refactored code and name them only through ::class, which never autoloads them.
The plugin runs inside Composer, which provides those classes itself; composer-plugin-api is the requirement, and composer/composer serves the analysis and the tests.
Composer provides symfony/console to a plugin at run time, as it provides its own classes; requiring it would install a copy beside the one Composer runs.

exclude.reason: Rector rule fixtures hold input and expected output; they are not code to style.

excludePaths.reason: Rector rule fixtures hold input and expected output; they are not code to analyse.

suppress.reason: Rector sets AbstractRector's services through autowire() after construction.
The parity test's autoloader includes the fixture halves it writes at run time.

skip.reason: Rector rule fixtures hold input and expected output; they are not code to rewrite.
